name: Now playing webhook
description: Posts the song that starts to a web address of yours, as JSON.

settings.label: Web address
settings.description: Where each song is posted, an http or https address. Empty sends nothing.

settings.label: Access token
settings.description: Optional. Sent as a Bearer token with each post.

de.setting.url.description: Wohin jedes Lied gesendet wird, eine http- oder https-Adresse. Leer sendet nichts.
de.setting.token.description: Optional. Wird bei jedem Senden als Bearer-Token mitgeschickt.
